title: we-report structured query (v1.2)
description: What the visual query builder produces. The backend validates every identifier against the introspected schema, quotes it for its dialect and sends every value as a driver parameter.

columns.description: Columns to return; all when omitted.

op.description: contains / startsWith (1.1): case-insensitive text match; the backend escapes % and _ in the value, so it is matched literally.

param.description: Name of a report parameter whose value is used instead of `value`.

nulls.description: 1.2 — where NULLs go. Without it the database decides (PostgreSQL puts them last when ascending, SQL Server first). A grid that shows groups asks for `first` so its row offsets match `groupBy`.

limit.description: Capped by the backend's own row limit.

distinct.description: 1.1 — SELECT DISTINCT over `columns` (which must then be given). Used for a grid's checklist filter values.

offset.description: 1.1 — rows to skip before `limit`, for paging. Use with `orderBy` for a stable order.

search.description: 1.2 (capability `search`) — a grid's search box: every word of `text` must appear, case-insensitively and literally, in at least one of `columns` read as text. Words AND, columns OR; combined with `where` by AND.

text.description: Split on whitespace; at most 10 words count.

groupBy.description: 1.2 (capability `groups`) — one result row per combination of these columns among the matched rows: the columns' values, `__count` (the rows in the group) and every `aggregates` entry under its `as`. Ordered by the groupBy columns ascending with NULL first, unless `orderBy` says otherwise. Not combined with `columns`, `distinct` or `offset`.

aggregates.description: 1.2 — subtotals per group (needs `groupBy`). `count` counts the non-NULL values of the column.

as.description: The key in the result row; unique, and not starting with `__`.
